title: High-dimensional nonparametric changepoint detection via low-rank degree-two density projection
abstract: arXiv:2608.13922v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Detecting distributional changes in high dimension is difficult when neither the pre-change nor post-change density is parametrically specified. We introduce a representation-based approach that retains all degree-at-most-two density information while replacing density estimation by matrix mean estimation. For observations in $[-1,1]^d$, a symmetric feature matrix $H_2(X)\in\R^{(d+1)\times(d+1)}$ is constructed so that $M(f)=\E_f H_2(X)$ is an isometric encoding of the degree-two orthogonal projection of the density. We scan matrix CUSUMs after rank-$r$ truncation, exploiting the low rank of the projected jump rather than sparsity of individual coordinates. The resulting \LRD{} estimator has a tent-shaped population objective and a nonasymptotic operator-norm analysis whose leading stochastic term scales as $\sqrt{rd\log(nd)}$. For multiple changes, we give a seeded narrowest-over-threshold procedure and prove exact recovery by an induct

translated_title: 高维非参数变点检测：通过低秩二次密度投影
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13922v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在高维环境中检测分布变化是困难的，尤其是在变化前和变化后的密度都没有参数化指定时。我们引入了一种基于表示的方法，该方法保留了所有次数至多为二的密度信息，同时将密度估计替换为矩阵均值估计。对于在$[-1,1]^d$中的观测值，我们构造了一个对称特征矩阵$H_2(X)\in\R^{(d+1)\times(d+1)}$，使得$M(f)=\E_f H_2(X)$是密度二次正交投影的等距编码。我们在秩-$r$截断后扫描矩阵CUSUM，利用投影跳跃的低秩性而非单个坐标的稀疏性。所提出的\LRD{}估计器具有帐篷形状的总体目标函数和非渐近算子范数分析，其主导随机项缩放为$\sqrt{rd\log(nd)}$。对于多个变化点，我们给出了一种种子化的最窄超过阈值程序，并通过归纳证明精确恢复。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于低秩二次密度投影的高维非参数变点检测方法，通过矩阵均值估计替代密度估计，并利用秩截断和CUSUM扫描实现高效检测，其复杂度随维度呈平方根增长。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a high-dimensional nonparametric changepoint detection method based on low-rank degree-two density projection, replacing density estimation with matrix mean estimation and leveraging rank truncation for efficient detection with complexity scaling as the square root of dimension.
